name: Fathym
description_en:
Fathym currently presents a family of AI workbench and team-tool products. fAI adds persistent context alongside an existing AI coding tool; OpenX turns connected data and queries into interfaces usable by apps and AI clients. This is broader than the legacy cloud-IDE description in the discovery record.

This profile concentrates on OpenX workshop-to-API delivery and the separate fAI installation/data-flow boundary. A proposed evaluation could expose one disposable reporting query, inspect its approval metadata and verify a consumer request. No workspace, installation, cloud deployment or model session was created.
description_zh:
Fathym 当前展示 AI 工作台及团队工具产品家族。fAI 在已有 AI 编码工具旁增加持久上下文，OpenX 将连接的数据与查询变为应用和 AI 客户端可用的接口，范围已不同于发现记录中的旧云端 IDE 描述。

本文聚焦 OpenX 从工作坊到 API 的交付，以及独立的 fAI 安装和数据流边界。建议用可丢弃报表查询评估审批信息和消费请求；本次未创建工作区、安装、云部署或模型会话。

review_notes: Original AI research draft based on the cited public official pages; no publication, price approval, independent review or product test is implied.
Earlier third-party feature and price claims are retained only in discovery provenance, not as current product evidence.

sections.title_en: Choose a product before comparing features
sections.en: OpenX is the team workshop; fAI is a personal context layer for existing AI coding tools. Holonic is described as their architecture, while Mosaic is still coming soon. Do not combine these names into one purchasable IDE or assume that a capability advertised for one is included in all. Start by deciding whether the task is preserving coding context or publishing a shared data tool.
sections.zh: OpenX 是团队工作坊，fAI 是已有 AI 编码工具的个人上下文层；Holonic 被介绍为架构，Mosaic 尚未推出。不能把这些名称合并成一个可购买的 IDE，也不能推定某产品功能全部通用。先确定任务是保留编码上下文，还是发布共享数据工具。

sections.title_en: A free draft is not a live endpoint
sections.title_zh: 免费草稿不是线上端点
sections.en: Sign in, create a workshop, then configure its data and query. Creating and building are free, but publishing APIs and MCP tools requires activating a plan. The workflow separates private drafts from changes that go live. The guide calls the Save icon both draft storage and the action that commits, followed by Deploy; inspect actual state before relying on button wording. A useful trial checks that an unshipped query remains private and that the released endpoint returns the intended dataset.
sections.zh: 登录、建工作坊后配置数据及查询。创建和构建免费，但发布 API／MCP 工具需启用计划。流程区分个人草稿与上线变更。指南既把 Save 描述为草稿存储，又说点击该图标提交后再 Deploy，操作前需核实真实状态。建议检查未发布查询的私有性和已发布接口的预期数据集。

sections.title_en: Treat the query URL and token as separate configuration
sections.title_zh: 分别配置查询 URL 与 token
sections.en: The API panel supplies a warm-query REST URL and request examples. API Keys supports an expiry from15 minutes to30 days or a custom duration; copy the token once and scope it to the integration. The response carries results and query approval identity/time. PowerBI uses the Web connector and authorization header; Grafana uses a JSON API source. Verify expiry handling, response shape and consumer credentials with a read-only dataset rather than treating a copied example as a working connection.
sections.zh: API 面板提供 warm query 的 REST URL 及请求示例。API Keys 可选15分钟至30天或自定义期限，token 仅复制一次，应按集成需要限权。响应含结果及查询审批人／时间。PowerBI 使用 Web 连接及授权头，Grafana 使用 JSON API 数据源。需以只读数据核对过期处理、响应结构和消费方凭据，复制示例不等于连接已可用。

sections.title_en: A configuration revert does not restore runtime data
sections.title_zh: 配置撤销不恢复运行数据
sections.en: The detailed guide includes connection settings, surface definitions, warm-query code, API settings and role assignments in a workshop commit. It explicitly excludes runtime data, logs and metrics. Reverting creates another commit. Evaluate a harmless query change and its access impact, then separately verify what happens to deployed consumers. This history cannot establish restoration of an external database, a downstream write or previously exposed data.
sections.zh: 详细指南将连接配置、数据面定义、warm query 代码、API 设置及角色分配纳入工作坊提交，明确排除运行数据、日志及指标；撤销会创建新提交。建议评估无害查询修改及权限影响，并另核已部署消费方的行为。该历史不能证明外部数据库、下游写入或已暴露数据可恢复。

sections.title_en: Local vaults do not mean zero outbound traffic
sections.title_zh: 本地知识库不等于零外发流量
sections.en: fAI requires an AI coding tool and git2.41 or later; its installer may add Deno and git, and first use selects synthesis and embedding providers. The telemetry guide says analytics are enabled by default and reports device/runtime metadata, detected tools/models and token counts, excluding code/prompts/vault contents. Opt-out settings exist. Debug prints events while still sending them, and the status command does not reflect one disable variable. Verify provider data handling separately from analytics. No installer or telemetry command was run.
sections.zh: fAI 依赖 AI 编码工具及 git2.41以上；安装程序可能添加 Deno／git，首次选择提炼与嵌入提供商。遥测指南称分析默认启用，报告设备／运行元数据、识别工具／模型及 token 数，不含代码／提示／知识库内容，可关闭。Debug 会打印且继续发送，状态命令未反映其中一个禁用变量。模型提供商的数据处理需独立核实，本次未运行安装或遥测命令。

sections.title_en: OpenX prices depend on runtime ownership
sections.title_zh: OpenX 费用取决于运行环境归属
sections.en: The monthly USD display lists Standard99.99 for shared Azure hosting with one Enterprise Workspace, Pro249.99 for a managed Azure runtime with unlimited workspaces and surface isolation, and Sovereign499.99 for self-hosted Azure with runtime/CLI access. The yearly selector advertises two months free but its checkout total was not verified. These are OpenX prices, not a uniform price or source-code license for all Fathym products. Confirm cloud charges, quotas, tax and operating responsibility before activation.
sections.zh: 美元月付展示为 Standard99.99：共享 Azure、一个 Enterprise Workspace；Pro249.99：托管 Azure、无限工作区及数据面隔离；Sovereign499.99：自托管 Azure、运行时／CLI 访问。年付选择宣传赠两个月，未核结账总额。这是 OpenX 费用，不是 Fathym 全家族统一售价或源码许可。启用前需确认云费用、额度、税及运行责任。
